title: Add locale-aware currency formatting
body:
## Summary

Adds `formatCents`, which formats integer cents with `Intl.NumberFormat` and validates the amount. Includes table-driven tests.

_Generated by the **Create demo branch** workflow (scenario: `clean`)._
expected: Few or no comments: the change follows all project conventions and is tested.
